coder_note: Pioneer Inn guest: smoke ~5 PM, fire jumping streets, staff ordered evacuation, hours in traffic, no power for gas
text: My 19 year old son and I just drove out from Lahaina. We were staying at the Pioneer Inn. Around 5 we smelled smoke from a fire a few blocks away. We went out to move our car and saw that the fire was uncontrolled. It was jumping from street to street, due to wind borne burning branches. We returned to the hotel and the staff announced that everyone had to leave the hotel and evacuate the town immediately. We sat in traffic for a few hours and then ran out of gas (no power so all the gas stations were closed). AAA and Kitagawa towing came through for us and we were back on the road for another 90 minutes and finally made it to Kahului. We smell like smoke and have ash in our hair.
